_about: Character voices for Pet Agents (English only). Each character's voice is cloned on your Mac by F5-TTS (MLX) from a few seconds of their real English-dub speech in Sounds/ (fetch with tools/sounds/fetch_sounds.py). No per-character model is downloaded. Install with tools/voice/install_voice.sh <character>.

reference.text: Believe it. I'm Naruto Uzumaki. Believe it.
reference.note: English dub (both clips checked with English speech recognition). 5.7 s in total; more clean English Naruto speech would improve the clone.

mission: Alright, let's do this, believe it!
summon: Naruto Uzumaki is here! Believe it!
